name: python_embedding_provider_switch
prompt:
Fix the Python embedding provider migration bug.

Requirements:
- Modify embedding_adapter.py only.
- get_embedding must handle every provider listed in provider_config.AVAILABLE_PROVIDERS.
- The new default provider (openai_v3) must be routed to a valid embedding function.
- Do not modify main.py or provider_config.py.
- Do not create new files.
- Use patch_candidate if only the PROVIDER_MAP mapping changes.
- target_snippet must be copied verbatim from the actual file.

Validation command: python main.py
